notes.title: 《Soccer Clubs 足球经理人》2nd Anniversary Version Update
notes.notes:
We will conduct a version shutdown and hot update on April 25th from 9:00-13:00, with the following updates:

1. Cross server competition function
*The World Cup regional and old regional data tables will be merged
2. Optimize the upper limit of VIP level
3. Player Awakens LV 50 additional bonus effects added
4. Content related to celebrating the 2nd anniversary
*Opening the 2nd Anniversary New Region
*Double VIP recharge experience (0426-0518)
5. Fix the issue where legendary Kahn player skills cannot be triggered

notes.title: "Soccer Clubs Football Manager"New version update
notes.notes:
Dear managers:

We will shut down the server for a hot update at 9:00 am on March 15, 2023, and the update time will be 7 hours.

Due to the network fluctuations of the developer, the in-game announcement failed to be sent, and we apologize for not being able to inform you in time.

[b]Update content:[/b]
1. Brand new tacit understanding and player captain skills
2. The player detailed information interface has been redesigned
3. Championship offline match function
4. The player level is open to level 120
5. Add wish scout function
6. The mysterious store is changed to a guest scout and optimized
7. Champion Journey increases favorability related content

[hr][/hr]
"Soccer Clubs Football Manager" steam official sincerely
